messages:
maria: Heads-up — after rolling kernel-selector v2 to canary (10% traffic) we're seeing ~8-12% increase in per-token cost on long-context routes (seq > 4k). Graph: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc/token-econ?orgId=1

tyler: Can you paste the per-route numbers? is it CPU/GPU time or accounting mismatch?

maria: quick snapshot: route=chat-long avg_token_latency_ms +9%, cpu_token_ms +1%, kernel_time_ms +30%, kv_miss_rate +5%

ashok: kernel_time +30% suggests fallback kernel chosen more often. Are we forcing kernel-hinting for those models? did selector change keys used for batch buckets?

maria: yeah we flipped "prefer_low_mem_kernels" flag in selector. Repro query below:

```
POST /v1/generate route=chat-long model=redwood-3B
payload: {"prompt": "x" * 5000}
```

response snippet (p99):
```
kernel=op_sparse_v2 fallback=matmul_compat
kernel_latency=42ms kv_cache_hit=false
```

claire: If kv_cache_hit false spikes, token accounting will attribute extra kernel work to each token. Could be double-counting during fallback. Can we check token-econ logs for duplicate emits?

tyler: checking logs now...

runtime-bot: deploy canary kernel-selector v2 started by @maria commit abc123

tyler: found this in econ logs: `token_accounting.emit` called twice for same request id ~ 120 samples. putting sample trace: trace_id=tr_456

ashok: that's our bug — selector triggers a second accounting emit when it falls back to compat kernel. Fix: de-dupe emits by request id in accounting layer and tag kernel_choice so dashboards split by initial vs final kernel.

maria: agreed. action items: 1) add dedupe in accounting (ashok) 2) add kernel_choice label to per_route.unit_cost (tyler) 3) rollback flag to old selector on canary until fix (claire)

claire: I'll open the rollout rollback and link the PR in this thread

tyler: I'll add grafana panel for kernel_choice and add alert if per-token cost delta > 5% for 5m

maria: thanks — will monitor after rollback. ping here when PRs linked :thumbsup:

claire: PR: https://git.redwood/infer/rollouts/pull/872

maria: noted. closing loop later with post-rollback numbers.
